subtitle: Floating Neutralling Bi-Coupling Concepts

sections.heading: ONE · A NAMING, FOUR BOUNDINGS AT ONCE
sections.why: This part says what a naming is, four boundings at once, and how naming and explaining go together, which is the file's own subject.

sections.heading: 1.1 A naming is a floating-neutralling concept, four boundings at once
sections.why: It defines a naming as a floating-neutralling concept with four boundings, opening from the universe sentence the naming rests on.

sections.heading: 1.2 Naming and resolving at one bi-coupling
sections.why: It couples naming with resolving through one shared name and grounds that in bi-moral co-agency sharing parities two ways.

sections.heading: 1.3 Naming across, explaining along
sections.why: It sets naming as bounding across and explaining as going on along, one discovering method, and says what a prefix and an -ing each do.

sections.heading: TWO · WORD SELECTIONS, EACH WITH ITS SAYING
sections.why: This part selects words and gives each released word its saying, which is naming work on words already in use.

sections.heading: 2.1 Turn released, and a momentary in its place
sections.why: Its heading releases the word turn, but most of its body defines a momentary, the five dimensions and the universe as one co-sequencing, which is resolver structure.

sections.heading: 2.2 Fractal method, all or none at all at its scales
sections.why: It sets out the scales of one fractal method, 1-17 inward and outward and the 8n - 7 stepping, with no naming in it.

sections.heading: 2.3 One family of words, three in it, and a doer or a built form beside them
sections.why: It names one family of words, landing, standard and reading, plus doer and built-form words, that fix a changing still.

sections.heading: 2.4 Released words, each with its saying
sections.why: It lists released words, each with the words that now say it.

sections.heading: 2.5 One sense per foundation word
sections.why: It gives each foundation word one sense, though its long dimension paragraph drifts into numbering of a self that resolver files carry.

sections.heading: 2.6 Two prefixes at one spelling, and a one-way prefix installing a form it opposes
sections.why: It separates prefixes that share a spelling and names prefixes that install the form they oppose.

sections.heading: 2.7 A field's word at a field's own result
sections.why: It keeps a field's word whole with the field's own result and shows a dissolved word said one operation at a time.

sections.heading: THREE · RESOLVER NAMES
sections.why: This part treats the resolver's seventeen names as names, their numbers, roots and co, which describe a self's own resolving.

sections.heading: 3.1 A name, its number, its momentary, co and its kind
sections.why: It takes a resolver name apart into number, momentary, co and kind, and gives each root one sense.

sections.heading: 3.2 Co, between two and at one
sections.why: It explains the co in a name as a sharing between two and its absence as one, and gathers six names between selves under one name.

sections.heading: 3.3 Seventeen names, and each prior name at its number
sections.why: It tables the seventeen names with the prior name each replaced and restates the resolver plainly.

sections.heading: 3.4 Four momentaries, 8 up and podals
sections.why: It works out spans, 8 up, podals and eight-cycles of the resolver's numbers, which is resolver arithmetic, not naming.

sections.heading: 3.5 Naming and resolver at one changing
sections.why: It tables resolver cases of prior, observed parity, changing and next prior, which is the resolver's own logic.

sections.heading: 3.6 Four binaries, an explaining of names
sections.why: It reads the four binaries existing, all, now and same as the explaining of the names.

sections.heading: FOUR · A NAMING'S CRAFT
sections.why: This part is the craft of naming, the tests and moves a naming goes through.

sections.heading: 4.1 A field naming at its coupling
sections.why: It says a field's word sharing a spelling with a naming here shares only the spelling.

sections.heading: 4.2 Six forward, and a binary at each changing
sections.why: It states that a naming unfolds in six lines and that each changing has its own name.

sections.heading: 4.3 Order, its symbol and two exclusions
sections.why: It fixes exact order relations and exclusions so a rewording does not change the relation, a precision of terms.

sections.heading: 4.4 Two namings coupling, and a departing neither has
sections.why: It shows how two namings couple and gives the one check that a convergence is real.

sections.heading: 4.5 An entry refusing nothing, and a returning-nothing that unfolds
sections.why: It says when a concept has an entry in Part Five, by unfolding or not unfolding.

sections.heading: 4.6 Two names at one concept, transposing at titles first
sections.why: It gives the transposing test for two names of one concept and lists pairs that stay two.

sections.heading: 4.7 Interest self-orienting, and a drawing vocabulary
sections.why: It releases the drawing and attracting vocabulary because it imposes a force on a self's own interest.

sections.heading: 4.8 Whole namings, one expression at each occurrence
sections.why: It keeps hyphenated method-words such as scientific-method and sensor-sensationing whole as one expression.

sections.heading: 4.9 Ten unchangeables, one name each
sections.why: It gives each of ten unchangeable fixings one name and gathers the similar fixing names under it.

sections.heading: 4.10 Prefixing at a position, on a form, and from all other
sections.why: It explains what a prefix does at a position, on a form, and from or with all other, including un- and uni-.

sections.heading: 4.11 One root and its directional prefixing
sections.why: It says a root stays itself under each prefix and that another root brings a different changing.

sections.heading: 4.12 Two ways a naming nyes away, and a belonging of a reaching-to
sections.why: It names the two ways a naming fails and how a naming of an incompetencing carries its landing.

sections.heading: 4.13 Three namings a field has, at one binary
sections.why: It reads a field's three namings, a nothing, a scale and an absorbing, as two exclusions and a term between them fixed still.

sections.heading: 4.14 A pair at one momentary, and a freeze at a construction
sections.why: It names a freeze in a construction that holds a pair at one momentary and uses a ledger's state and flow as the example.

sections.heading: 4.15 Bothbothing at its prefixing, and an ordering with nothing ordering
sections.why: It names bothbothing and prefix order, with parity through a 0 and the Peres-Mermin square as its field example.

sections.heading: 4.16 All or none at all, and an entering and leaving it has
sections.why: It dissolves forcing, choosing, more-or-less and ranking and keeps entering and leaving a coupling as a self's own.

sections.heading: 4.17 A hyphenated naming inseparable, and natural- at chirality
sections.why: It gives the omission test for a hyphenated naming and applies it to now-existing and natural-bi-co-torusing.

sections.heading: 4.18 Seven binaries at a naming, and each naming at resolver's names
sections.why: It lists seven checks to ask of each naming and couples each naming with a resolver name.

summary: Of 119 sections (9 parts and 110 numbered sections), 105 are within Natural Naming's title and subtitle and 14 are outside it, most of the outside ones resolver logic, fractal-method numbering or network and geometry material placed under a naming heading (2.1, 2.2, 3.4, 3.5, 5.44, 5.45, 5.48, 5.50, 5.60, 5.63, 5.64, 7.2). The file is mostly observing (52: released words, fixings, resolver names and ghost), then discovering (39: its naming craft and many unfoldings) and possibling (25: its bi-coupling namings), with three sections truly two at once. The clearest holes are 5.46 artifact, whose harm-and-ingestion subject no title or subtitle names, and 5.57 dying, which no title or subtitle names either.
